info.name: Nile Marketplace API (Release 1 + R2-P1…P7)
info.description:
Every endpoint built so far: health, API docs, identity (spec 03), customers (spec 04), sellers (spec 05), catalog with seller stock (spec 06), cart (spec 08), checkout and orders with COD and Kashier (spec 09), payments and refunds (spec 10), delivery (spec 11): governorates and fees, agents, shipments and the work of delivery agents, and finance (spec 12): balances, statements, COD remittances and payouts.

Variables: set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:3000) and `mailpitUrl` (local only). Login, verify, accept-invite and refresh store `accessToken`, `refreshToken` and `userId` automatically; admin routes use the stored `accessToken`.

Local first run (docker compose):
1. `docker compose run --rm api node dist/seed-admin.js --email you@example.com`, then set the `email` variable to that address.
2. Local helpers (Mailpit) → "Latest email" → "Extract OTP / invite token".
3. Auth → "Accept invite" (sets your password and logs you in).
4. Admin requests now work with the stored access token.

Customer / seller flow: set `email` to a fresh address → "Register customer" (or "Register seller") → Local helpers → "Latest email" → "Extract OTP / invite token" → Auth → "Verify email" (logs you in). "Delivery" → "List governorates" stores Cairo in `governorateId` first, because addresses and pickup addresses need one.

Sample delivery fees and a sample catalog for local dev: `npm run seed:dev` (none is deliverable until an admin sets fees; the catalog has a category tree with attributes and an approved demo seller with active products).

Catalog flow: "Admin: catalog" → Create category → Add attribute → Add option (stores `categoryId`, `attributeId`, `optionId`). Then log in as an approved seller → "Seller: catalog" → Create product → Add variant (put option ids in `optionIds`, or `[]` in a category without attributes) → Activate. "Catalog" (public) → List products / Product detail.

Cart flow: log in as a customer → "Catalog" → List products → Product detail (stores the first variant in `variantId`) → "Cart" → Add item (stores the line in `cartItemId`) → My cart → Change quantity / Remove item / Empty cart.

Order flow (COD): with items in the cart and an address (`addressId`) in a deliverable governorate → "Checkout & orders" → Checkout. The first send usually answers 409 ORDER_TOTAL_CHANGED and stores the current total in `expectedTotal`; send again. It stores `orderId`, `sellerOrderId` and `orderItemId`. Log in as that seller → "Seller: orders" → Accept → Ready (or Cancel item quantities / Cancel). Ready creates the shipment and assigns it to an on-shift agent of the pickup governorate (the worker must run).

Kashier flow (local, PAYMENT_GATEWAY=fake): set `paymentMethod` to kashier → Checkout (the order awaits payment; the fake payment page URL is not a real page). Pay it with `npm run dev:kashier-webhook -- {{orderId}}` (or `... failed`, or an amount to try a mismatch); the worker then places the order. "Kashier payment page" asks again for the page while the window is open. Unpaid orders are cancelled by the worker after KASHIER_PAYMENT_TTL_MINUTES. "Admin: payments" shows the payment, its webhook events and the refund queue.

Delivery flow: as admin → "Admin: delivery agents & shipments" → Create agent (set `agentEmail` to a fresh address and `governorateId` to the seller's governorate). Set `email` to `agentEmail` → Local helpers → Latest email → Extract OTP / invite token → Auth → Accept invite (logs the agent in). "Agent" → Go on shift. After a seller marks an order ready: My shipments → Picked up → Out for delivery (stores `amountToCollect`) → Delivered, or Failed attempt. `npm run seed:dev` also creates a demo agent in Cairo.

Finance flow: once an order is delivered (the worker books it in the ledger) → "Admin: finance" → List accounts (stores the first in `accountId`) → Account statement; "Entries of a seller order" uses `sellerOrderId`. "Confirm COD remittance" takes cash from `agentId`; "Record payout" pays `sellerId` (set it to the seller's id) with a fresh `payoutReference`. Log in as the seller → "Seller: finance", or as the agent → "Agent: finance", to see the same money from their side.

Release 2 so far: the audit log (spec 20 §2), image uploads (spec 14) with product and category images (spec 06 §8), the notification centre and Web Push (spec 13 §8), the web refresh cookie (spec 03 §8), support tickets (spec 16), reviews and ratings (spec 17), the wishlist (spec 04 §8), returns (spec 18) with automated refunds (spec 10 §8) and the seller holding period (spec 12 §8), and coupons (spec 19). The live socket (spec 15) is not HTTP: see docs/realtime.md.

Image flow: "Media" → Request upload (stores `mediaId`) → POST the file to the returned `upload.url` with every `upload.fields` entry first and the file last as `file` (multipart/form-data; in Postman a new request, Body → form-data) → Complete upload → poll Get media until `ready` (the worker processes it). Then attach it: "Seller: product images" → Add image, or "Admin: category images" → Set image.

Support flow: log in as a customer or seller → "Support" → Open ticket (stores `ticketId`) → Messages / Post message. Log in as an admin → "Admin: support" → Queue → Reply (the first reply assigns the ticket to you) or Internal note → Resolve / Close. Attachments: upload with purpose support_attachment first, then pass the `mediaId` in `attachmentMediaIds`.

Review flow: a customer with a delivered order → "Reviews" → Reviewable items (stores `orderItemId`) → Write a review (stores `reviewId`); the worker moves the product and seller ratings. Log in as the seller → "Seller: reviews" → Reply. As an admin → "Admin: reviews" → Hide / Unhide. "Catalog" → Product reviews / Review summary show the public side.

Back-office flow (admin): "Admin: dashboard" shows the figures (cached for DASHBOARD_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS; generatedAt is their age). "Admin: users" → List users finds any account; "Admin: customers" → List customers (stores `customerId`) → Customer detail, then "Admin: orders" with customerId[eq]. "Admin: orders" → Cancel seller order / Cancel order (Idempotency-Key, a reason for the audit log). "Admin: products" → Product (admin view) → Block (the seller is notified and can no longer activate it) → Unblock. Every admin write appears in "Admin: audit log".

Return flow: a customer with a delivered order → "Returns" → Returnable items (uses `orderId` and `sellerOrderId`; stores the first line in `orderItemId`) → Request a return (Idempotency-Key; stores `returnId`; damaged / wrong_item / not_as_described need a photo: upload with purpose return_photo first; a COD order needs `refundPayout`). Log in as the seller → "Seller: returns" → Approve (or Reject; the customer may then Escalate and an admin decides in "Admin: returns"). The worker assigns the return pickup to an agent: "Agent" → My shipments → Picked up → Delivered (handed to the seller). The seller → Return detail (stores `returnItemId`) → Confirm receipt (or Dispute; an admin resolves it). The refund follows: Kashier refunds are sent by the worker; COD refunds wait in "Admin: payments" → Refund queue → Refund detail (shows the wallet / InstaPay details) → Record a refund. "Seller: finance" → My balance / My holds shows money held until the return window ends.

Coupon flow: as an admin → "Admin: coupons" → Create a platform coupon (stores `couponId` and `couponCode`), or as an approved seller → "Seller: coupons" → Create a coupon for your products. As a customer with items in the cart → "Cart" → Coupon preview shows the discount per seller and line (nothing is stored). Then "Checkout & orders" → Checkout with a coupon: expectedTotal must be the discounted total (the first send stores it from ORDER_TOTAL_CHANGED). After the first use only endsAt, globalLimit and status can change. An admin may block a seller coupon ("Admin: coupons" → Block): it goes inactive and the seller is notified.
Tokens are per account: log in as the admin again (Auth → Login) before the "Admin: …" folders.

Errors use the envelope { success: false, error: { code, message, details? }, correlationId }. Every request sends a fresh X-Correlation-Id (collection pre-request script); search the api/worker logs for it.

exec: // One correlation id per request, echoed by the API and present in every log line (G26).

request.description: Process is up. No dependency checks, no auth, not rate limited.
Postgres, Redis and RabbitMQ, each with a timeout. 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with one detail per dependency that is down.
OpenAPI 3.1, generated from the DTOs. Only when API_DOCS_ENABLED=true (off in production). Swagger UI: {{baseUrl}}/api/v1/docs/

item.name: Auth
item.description: spec 03 §4.2–§4.9b. Public routes are rate limited per IP and per email (strict-auth); refresh and logout per IP.

request.description: 200 token pair. Errors: INVALID_CREDENTIALS 401 (unknown email, wrong password and invited account all get the same answer), EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED 403, ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED 403 (only after a correct password). `deviceName` is optional (1..100); `null` is rejected.
Rotates the refresh token (43 chars). Reusing an old token revokes the whole session family: INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN 401. The app must not refresh concurrently.

The web transport (spec 03 §8, R-21): no body; the refresh token travels in the HttpOnly cookie that a login sent with `X-Nile-Client: web` sets (Postman keeps it in its cookie jar for the api host). The response carries the access token only and rotates the cookie. Without the header the body transport applies.
Ends this device's session. Always 204, even for an unknown token.

Sets the password of an invited admin or delivery agent, activates the account and logs in. The token comes from the invite link (?token=…; see Local helpers). Single use. Errors: INVALID_INVITE_TOKEN 400. Password: 8+ characters, max 72 UTF-8 bytes, never trimmed.
Activates a pending account with the 6-digit OTP and logs in. Errors: INVALID_OTP 400 (one generic code). Each wrong code counts; after OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS even the right code fails.
Always 200 with the same message. A new code is sent only to a pending account outside the cooldown (OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS); it invalidates the previous code.
Always 200 with the same message. Sends a password-reset OTP to an active account (cooldown applies).
Sets a new password with the reset OTP and revokes every session. 204; then log in again. Errors: INVALID_OTP 400.

Any logged-in role. Keeps the session of `refreshToken` and revokes all others. 204. Errors, in this order: INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD 400, PASSWORD_UNCHANGED 422, INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN 401. Rate limit: IP + the account email (shared with login).

item.name: Admin: users
item.description: spec 03 §4.10–§4.13. Admin role only: 401 without a token, 403 for other roles.

request.description: 201 { id, email, role: admin, status: invited, createdAt }. The invite email is queued; the worker sends it. Errors: EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED 409. The test stores the new id in `targetUserId`.

query.description: eq | in: pending_email_verification, invited, active, suspended

request.description: Cursor pagination: meta { nextCursor, hasMore, limit }. Unknown fields, operators or sorts: INVALID_QUERY 400. The test stores nextCursor in `cursor`; enable the cursor param to fetch the next page.

query.description: eq | in: pending_email_verification, invited, active, suspended

request.description: spec 20 §3.3. Every role. 200 { id, email, role, status, emailVerifiedAt, lastLoginAt, createdAt }[] + meta. INVALID_QUERY 400. The test stores the first id in `targetUserId`.
New invite link; the previous one stops working. 204. Errors: USER_NOT_FOUND 404, USER_NOT_INVITED 409, VALIDATION_FAILED 400 for an id that is not a UUIDv7.

Customers and admins only (S-2); active → suspended; revokes every session. 200 { id, email, role, status }. Errors: USER_NOT_FOUND 404, USER_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409 (already suspended, not active, seller or agent), CANNOT_SUSPEND_SELF 409. `reason` 3..500 chars, kept in the audit log.
suspended → active. 200 { id, email, role, status }. Errors: USER_NOT_FOUND 404, USER_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.

item.name: Admin: customers
item.description: spec 20 §3.3. Admin role. Reads only, not audited.

request.description: 200 { id, userId, email, firstName, lastName, phone, userStatus, createdAt }[] + meta. The test stores the first id in `customerId`.
The list item plus addressCount. Their orders: "Admin: orders" → List orders with customerId[eq]. CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND 404.

item.name: Delivery
item.description: spec 11 §4.1. Public, general rate limit.

request.description: All 27, ordered by name (English; localize by `code`, ISO 3166-2:EG). `deliveryFee` null = not deliverable. Cached in Redis. The test stores Cairo (EG-C) in `governorateId`.

item.name: Customer
item.description: spec 04. Registration is public (strict-auth rate limit); everything else needs a customer token (403 for other roles).

request.description: 201 { userId, email, status: pending_email_verification }. A verification OTP is emailed; no tokens until Auth → "Verify email". Errors: EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED 409. Phone: Egyptian mobile in E.164 (+2010/11/12/15…).
At least one of firstName, lastName, phone. The email cannot be changed.
No pagination (max CUSTOMER_MAX_ADDRESSES). The default first, then newest first.

body.raw:
{
  "label": "Home",
  "recipientName": "Mona Ali",
  "recipientPhone": "+201001234567",
  "governorateId": "{{governorateId}}",
  "city": "Cairo",
  "area": "Zamalek",
  "street": "26th of July St",
  "building": "12",
  "floor": "3",
  "apartment": null,
  "landmark": null,
  "isDefault": true
}

request.description: 201. Becomes the default when isDefault=true or when there is no default yet. Errors: ADDRESS_LIMIT_REACHED 422, GOVERNORATE_NOT_FOUND 422. The test stores the id in `addressId`.
ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND 404 when missing, deleted or another customer's.
Any subset of the fields; null clears floor / apartment / landmark. isDefault=true moves the default here; isDefault=false on the default → DEFAULT_ADDRESS_UNSET_NOT_ALLOWED 422.
Soft delete, 204. Deleting the default leaves no default. Past orders keep their copy.

item.name: Seller
item.description: spec 05 §4.2–§4.3. Registration is public (strict-auth rate limit); the rest needs a seller token.

request.description: 201 { userId, sellerId, email, status: pending_email_verification, sellerStatus: pending_approval }. Verify the email, then an admin approves. Errors: EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED 409, BUSINESS_NAME_TAKEN 409 (case-insensitive), GOVERNORATE_NOT_FOUND 422. The test stores `sellerId`.
Includes status, rejectionReason (after a rejection) and commissionRate.
Any status; no re-approval. pickupAddress (optional) replaces the whole address. Errors: BUSINESS_NAME_TAKEN 409, GOVERNORATE_NOT_FOUND 422.
rejected → pending_approval. Otherwise SELLER_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.

item.name: Admin: sellers
item.description: spec 05 §4.4. Admin role only. Every decision returns the seller detail.

request.description: The approval queue by default here (status=pending_approval). Cursor pagination; INVALID_QUERY 400 for anything off the whitelist. The test stores the first id in `sellerId` and nextCursor in `cursor`.
Pickup address, emailVerified, and the newest 50 status / commission history entries.
pending_approval → approved; publishes seller.approved. Errors: SELLER_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED 409, SELLER_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409, SELLER_NOT_FOUND 404.
pending_approval → rejected. `reason` 3..500, shown to the seller until the next decision.
approved → suspended; publishes seller.suspended (catalog hides the products). Open orders continue; login still works.
suspended → approved; publishes seller.approved (previousStatus suspended). The body is optional.
Rate string 0..1, up to 4 decimals. New checkouts only. COMMISSION_RATE_UNCHANGED 409 for the current rate.
Applies to sellers who register afterwards; existing sellers keep their own rate.

item.name: Admin: delivery
item.description: spec 11 §4.3 (reference data). Admin role only.

request.description: Money string, or null to stop delivering there. New checkouts only; clears the cached list. GOVERNORATE_NOT_FOUND 404.
The agents' share of the delivery fee (Q-34). New checkouts only.

item.name: Catalog
item.description: spec 06 §4.1. Public, general rate limit. Only visible products: active, seller approved, not deleted.

request.description: Active categories, nested, ordered by sortOrder then name. Cached.
Own and inherited attributes with their options, ancestors first. CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND 404 (missing or inactive).

Filters: categoryId[eq] (includes subcategories), price[gte|lte] (lowest variant price), inStock[eq], sellerId[eq], rating[gte] (1..5; unrated never match), attr.<code>[in] (needs categoryId; all attr filters must match the same variant; max 5). q: search text 2..100 (full text + typo tolerant). Sort: publishedAt, minPrice, rating (unrated last on -rating), relevance (with q only). Default: -relevance with q, else -publishedAt.
By id or slug. Active variants with live stock (availableQuantity = min(sellable, 99)); attributes list only the options variants use. PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND 404 when hidden or deleted.

item.name: Admin: catalog
item.description: spec 06 §4.2. Admin role only. Every change clears the cached category tree.

request.description: Inactive categories included, each with its own attributes and options.

parentId null = root; max depth 3. slug defaults to the kebab-cased name. CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND 422, CATEGORY_PARENT_INACTIVE 409, CATEGORY_MAX_DEPTH_EXCEEDED 422, CATEGORY_NAME_TAKEN 409, CATEGORY_SLUG_TAKEN 409, CATEGORY_SLUG_REQUIRED 422, CATEGORY_CHILD_LIMIT_REACHED 422.

name, slug, sortOrder, isActive. Deactivating needs no active child and no product (CATEGORY_IN_USE 409); activating needs an active parent (CATEGORY_PARENT_INACTIVE 409). Categories never move or get deleted.
Inherited by subcategories; max 5 per category including inherited ones. Only while the subtree has no product. ATTRIBUTE_CODE_CONFLICT 409, CATEGORY_HAS_PRODUCTS 409, ATTRIBUTE_LIMIT_REACHED 422.
name, sortOrder. The code is immutable (it is the public filter key).
Max 100 per attribute. OPTION_CODE_TAKEN 409, OPTION_LIMIT_REACHED 422.
Only when no variant (deleted ones included) uses it: OPTION_IN_USE 409.
Deletes its options too. Only when the subtree has no product, deleted ones included: ATTRIBUTE_IN_USE 409.

item.name: Seller: catalog
item.description: spec 06 §4.3. Seller role. Writes need an approved seller (SELLER_NOT_APPROVED 403); reads work in any status. Another seller's product or variant is not found (404).

request.description: Filters: status[eq|in], categoryId[eq], name[like], createdAt[gte|lte]. Sort: createdAt (default -createdAt).
Created as a draft with an immutable slug (name + 6 random chars). CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND 422 (missing or inactive).
With live variants, their options and stock.
name, description, categoryId (only while the product has no variant: PRODUCT_CATEGORY_LOCKED 409).

optionIds: exactly one option per attribute of the category (own and inherited), or [] when it has none (then a single default variant). VARIANT_OPTIONS_INVALID 422 (details), DEFAULT_VARIANT_EXISTS 409, VARIANT_COMBINATION_EXISTS 409, SKU_TAKEN 409, VARIANT_LIMIT_REACHED 422, COMPARE_AT_PRICE_INVALID 422.
sku, price, compareAtPrice (null clears it), status. Options are fixed: delete the variant and add another.
draft or inactive → active. Needs an active variant: PRODUCT_HAS_NO_ACTIVE_VARIANT 409.
active → inactive (PRODUCT_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409 otherwise).
A delta (+/-), never an absolute value (S-6). Idempotency-Key required (a fresh one per send here). STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_INVALID 422 when stock would go below 0 or below the reserved quantity.
Newest first, cursor-paginated.
Soft delete. If it was the last active variant of an active product, the product becomes inactive.
Soft delete of the product and its variants.

item.name: Cart
item.description: spec 08 §4. Customer role only, general rate limit, no Idempotency-Key (adds are summed, so a retry adds twice). Every write returns the whole cart except the deletes (204). Prices, stock and availability are live; lines with an issue (UNAVAILABLE, OUT_OF_STOCK, INSUFFICIENT_STOCK) are shown but left out of the totals.

request.description: Grouped by seller (by earliest line), lines in the order they were added. id is null until the first add; a GET never creates a cart.

quantity 1..99. An existing line of the same variant gets the quantity added (always 201). VARIANT_NOT_PURCHASABLE 422, CART_ITEM_QUANTITY_LIMIT 422 (line over 99), CART_LINE_LIMIT_REACHED 422 (CART_MAX_LINES), INSUFFICIENT_STOCK 409 (details: available).
Sets the absolute quantity (1..99). CART_ITEM_NOT_FOUND 404, VARIANT_NOT_PURCHASABLE 422 (an unavailable line can only be removed), INSUFFICIENT_STOCK 409.
CART_ITEM_NOT_FOUND 404.
Removes every line; 204 also when there is no cart yet.

What {{couponCode}} would take off the cart, per seller and line; lines with an issue are left out. Nothing is stored: send the code again at checkout. Its own per-user rate limit (coupon-preview, 429). 422: CART_EMPTY, COUPON_NOT_FOUND, COUPON_INACTIVE, COUPON_NOT_ACTIVE_YET, COUPON_EXPIRED, COUPON_LIMIT_REACHED, COUPON_CUSTOMER_LIMIT_REACHED, COUPON_NOT_APPLICABLE, COUPON_MIN_SUBTOTAL_NOT_MET (details[0].value = the missing amount).

item.name: Checkout & orders
item.description: spec 09 §4.1. Customer role. Checkout (paymentMethod cod | kashier) needs an Idempotency-Key and has its own per-user rate limit, shared with "Kashier payment page". Amounts are EGP strings.

exec: if (kashier) console.log('Kashier payment page:', kashier.checkoutUrl, 'until', kashier.expiresAt);

request.description: Places the cart as one order split per seller, reserves stock and empties the cart (201). COD: placed. Kashier: pending_payment, with data.kashier.checkoutUrl (null if Kashier failed: use "Kashier payment page"). CART_EMPTY 422, CART_HAS_ISSUES 409 (details: variant ids), ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND 422, GOVERNORATE_NOT_DELIVERABLE 422, ORDER_TOTAL_CHANGED 409 (details[0].value = current total; stored in expectedTotal), ORDER_PAYMENT_PENDING 409 (Kashier while you have an unpaid order; details[0].value = its id), INSUFFICIENT_STOCK 409. A repeat with the same Idempotency-Key replays the first answer.

As Checkout, with {{couponCode}}: the items are discounted (never the delivery fee) and expectedTotal is the discounted total. data.order.coupon shows the code and discount; seller orders show discountAmount and discountFunding, lines discountAmount and paidTotal. The coupon codes of Coupon preview answer 422 and nothing is placed. KASHIER_TOTAL_ZERO 422: a Kashier order that would cost 0.00 (use cod).
Newest first. itemCount = units still to deliver.
Seller orders with items and timelines, shipping snapshot, payment status. ORDER_NOT_FOUND 404.

The payment page of a Kashier order while it awaits payment; the same session every time. ORDER_NOT_FOUND 404, ORDER_NOT_AWAITING_PAYMENT 409 (COD, paid, or the window closed), PAYMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE 502 (retry).
Only while placed (canCancel). Releases its stock; the order total drops (OR-13). SELLER_ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE 409, ORDER_NOT_FOUND / SELLER_ORDER_NOT_FOUND 404.

item.name: Seller: orders
item.description: spec 09 §4.2. Seller role, any seller status (open orders continue after a suspension). No customer name, phone or address (S-11); orders awaiting payment are never shown. Each action answers with the seller order after the change.

request.description: SELLER_ORDER_NOT_FOUND 404.
placed → accepted, also after the deadline until the timeout job ran. SELLER_ORDER_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.
accepted → ready_for_pickup; publishes seller_order.ready_for_pickup (delivery creates the shipment from Phase 6).

reason out_of_stock | seller_request | other (note required for other). Until picked up. Cancelling every open unit cancels the seller order. ITEM_CANCEL_QUANTITY_INVALID 422, ORDER_ITEM_NOT_FOUND 404, SELLER_ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE 409.
The whole seller order, until picked up; stock is released. SELLER_ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE 409.
returning_to_seller → returned_to_seller; stock is released. SELLER_ORDER_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.

item.name: Admin: orders
item.description: spec 09 §4.3, §8.4. Admin role. Cancellations need an Idempotency-Key and a reason (3..500, admins only; the customer sees cancelReason admin_cancelled).

request.description: Adds commission per seller order and the full status histories (actor role, actor id, reason).

From placed, accepted or ready_for_pickup: releases stock, flags a refund for a paid Kashier order, writes an audit row. 200 the admin order detail. SELLER_ORDER_NOT_FOUND 404, SELLER_ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE 409.

All or nothing (OR-17): every open seller order is cancelled, or none when one is past ready_for_pickup. 200 the admin order detail. ORDER_NOT_FOUND 404, ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE 409 (details: the blocking sellerOrderIds; none when nothing is left to cancel).

item.name: Admin: products
item.description: spec 20 §3.4. Admin role. Uses `productId`. A block takes the product off the shop (active → inactive) and refuses activation until unblocked; the seller may still edit it.

request.description: The seller's product detail (any status) plus sellerId, adminBlocked and adminBlockReason. PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND 404.
`reason` 3..500, shown to the seller in their product view. The seller is notified (product_blocked). 200 the admin view. PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND 404, PRODUCT_BLOCK_INVALID_STATUS 409 (already blocked).
Clears the block; the product stays inactive for the seller to activate. 200 the admin view. PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND 404, PRODUCT_BLOCK_INVALID_STATUS 409 (not blocked).

item.name: Admin: dashboard
item.description: spec 20 §3.2. Admin role. Days are Cairo business days.

request.description: orders (open seller orders by status, placedToday, placedLast7Days), gmv (30 days ending today: placed and delivered), topSellers (10, by delivered GMV over the same days), sellers.pendingApproval, support, finance (codOutstanding, sellerPayable, agentFeePayable), delivery. Cached for DASHBOARD_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS; generatedAt is when it was computed.

item.name: Admin: payments
item.description: spec 10 §4.2, §8. Admin role. Kashier refunds are sent by the worker (pending_auto → processing → succeeded). Every COD refund, R1 refunds and a Kashier refund the worker could not settle wait as pending_manual: pay it by hand (Kashier dashboard, wallet or InstaPay), then record it here. The queue lists refunds oldest first.

request.description: Amounts, Kashier references, refunds and webhook events (no payloads). PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND 404.
status: pending_auto, processing, succeeded, pending_manual, recorded. lastError says why a refund waits for an admin. Stores the first in refundId.
The refund plus, for a COD return refund, the decrypted payoutDetails (mobile_wallet walletNumber or instapay instapayAddress) to pay it to. REFUND_NOT_FOUND 404.

Hands a pending_manual Kashier refund back to the worker (pending_auto) once the cause is fixed. Check the Kashier dashboard first: never retry a refund Kashier may already have applied. REFUND_NOT_FOUND 404, REFUND_NOT_RETRYABLE 409.

After paying by hand: the Kashier refund reference, or the wallet / InstaPay transfer reference for COD. A Kashier payment becomes partially_refunded or refunded; COD keeps its status. REFUND_NOT_FOUND 404, REFUND_ALREADY_RECORDED 409.

item.name: Admin: delivery agents & shipments
item.description: spec 11 §4.3 (agents, shipments). Admin role only.

request.description: An active agent, off shift, with an invited login: the invite is emailed (Mailpit locally). EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED 409, GOVERNORATE_NOT_FOUND 422. Stores agentId.
AGENT_NOT_FOUND 404.
Any of fullName, phone, homeGovernorateId. GOVERNORATE_NOT_FOUND 422.
Off shift, no new work, an active login suspended. AGENT_HAS_ACTIVE_SHIPMENTS 409 (reassign them first), AGENT_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.
A suspended login is reactivated. AGENT_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.
Stores the first shipment in shipmentId.
With its attempts and status history. SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND 404.

Assign or reassign before pickup, to any active agent (shift and governorate may be overridden). AGENT_NOT_FOUND 422, AGENT_INACTIVE 409, SHIPMENT_NOT_ASSIGNABLE 409, SHIPMENT_ALREADY_ASSIGNED_TO_AGENT 409.

item.name: Agent
item.description: spec 11 §4.2. Log in as the agent first (accept the invite from Mailpit). Every request but "My agent profile" needs an active agent (403 AGENT_INACTIVE).

request.description: On shift, new shipments picked up in your home governorate are assigned to you. Going off shift keeps current ones.

Without a status filter the active ones, oldest first; enable status[in] for the history. kind is delivery or return: a return is collected at dropoff (the customer) and handed over at pickup (the seller) with Picked up → Delivered, or Failed attempt; nothing to collect. Stores the first one in shipmentId.
SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND 404, also for a shipment of another agent.
assigned → picked_up. SHIPMENT_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.
picked_up or delivery_failed → out_for_delivery. The first COD parcel of a checkout to go out carries the delivery fee: amountToCollect = items + fee. Stores it in amountToCollect.
COD: codCollectedAmount must equal amountToCollect (COD_AMOUNT_MISMATCH / COD_AMOUNT_REQUIRED 422). Kashier: send no body (COD_AMOUNT_NOT_ALLOWED 422).

reason: customer_unreachable | customer_refused | wrong_address | customer_rescheduled. Refused or the 3rd attempt → returning_to_seller (the seller confirms the return in "Seller: orders"); otherwise delivery_failed, and the fee moves to the next parcel going out.
Only for a parcel whose seller order was cancelled after you picked it up: you handed it back to the seller. SHIPMENT_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409 otherwise.

item.name: Admin: finance
item.description: spec 12 §4.1. Admin role. Balances and statements come from the ledger, booked by the worker when a seller order is delivered and when an order closes. Remittances and payouts need an Idempotency-Key.

request.description: With the owner's name (seller business name / agent name; null for the platform accounts). Default sort -balance; platform_delivery_revenue may be negative. Stores the first in accountId.
ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND 404.
Every entry with its balanceAfter, newest first. ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND 404.
Every money movement of one reference (seller_order, order, cod_remittance, payout), with its accountId. Both parameters required (INVALID_QUERY 400); not paginated.
Cash the agent handed in; debits their COD cash. AGENT_NOT_FOUND 422, REMITTANCE_EXCEEDS_BALANCE 422 (also when the agent holds no cash yet).

A transfer made outside the system (payeeType seller or agent; an agent is paid their fee shares). paidAt needs a time zone and may not be in the future. PAYEE_NOT_FOUND 422, PAYOUT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE 422, PAID_AT_IN_FUTURE 422, PAYOUT_ALREADY_RECORDED 409 (same externalReference for this payee: change payoutReference).

item.name: Seller: finance
item.description: spec 12 §4.2. Log in as the seller first. Read-only; works in any seller status.

request.description: available: what the platform owes you now (may be negative after a seller-fault return fee; no payout while it is). pending: earnings held until their return windows end. "0.00" and updatedAt null before your first delivery.
Earnings still held per seller order, next release first. blockedByReturn: an open return keeps it held past releaseAfter. The worker releases due holds into your available balance.

item.name: Agent: finance
item.description: spec 12 §4.3. Log in as the agent first. Read-only; works for an inactive agent too.

request.description: feePayable: fee shares the platform owes you. codCashHeld: platform cash you still hold.
account is required: fee (your fee shares) or cod (cash collected and handed in). INVALID_QUERY 400.

item.name: Admin: audit log
item.description: spec 20 §2. Every admin write leaves an append-only row; reads are not audited.

request.description: Newest first. Stores the first entry in `auditEntryId`.
AUDIT_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND 404.

item.name: Media
item.description: spec 14. Customers, sellers and admins; rate class `upload` per user. Purposes: product_image (sellers), category_image (admins), review_image (customers), support_attachment (all three, private), return_photo (customers, private).

request.description: 201 { media, upload: { url, fields, expiresAt } }: POST the file straight to storage with that form. Stores `mediaId`. Errors: MEDIA_PURPOSE_NOT_ALLOWED 403, MEDIA_OPEN_UPLOAD_LIMIT_REACHED 422.
202 processing (200 when already processing or ready). Errors: MEDIA_UPLOAD_MISSING 409 (the file is not in storage yet), MEDIA_UPLOAD_INVALID 422, MEDIA_INVALID_STATUS 409.
Your upload: poll until status is ready (with image URLs) or failed. MEDIA_NOT_FOUND 404.

item.name: Seller: product images
item.description: spec 06 §8. Up to 8 per product, from your own ready product_image uploads. Log in as the seller first.

request.description: Answers every image of the product. Optional `position` (0..7; past the end appends) and `variantId` (an image of one variant). Stores the last image in `imageId`. Errors: MEDIA_NOT_ATTACHABLE 422, the 8-image limit 422.
`variantId` and / or `altText`; at least one.
Every image id of the product, once each, in the new order.

item.name: Admin: category images
item.description: spec 06 §8. Any admin may use any admin's ready category_image upload (ME-2). Audited.

request.description: Setting the same image again changes only the alt text.
A category without an image is a no-op.

item.name: Notifications & push
item.description: spec 13 §8. Any signed-in role. In-app rows are kept 90 days; preferences affect push only. Web Push needs a browser (pushManager.subscribe); the requests below show the shapes.

request.description: Newest first. Stores the first in `notificationId`.
Counted up to 100 (show "99+").
Idempotent. NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND 404.
All four categories with defaults filled in (promotions off).
Only the listed categories change.
The VAPID public key for pushManager.subscribe.
`PushSubscription.toJSON()` as the browser gives it. A host outside the allow-list: PUSH_ENDPOINT_NOT_ALLOWED 422. 10 per user; the 11th replaces the oldest.
Before logout. Always 204.

item.name: Support
item.description: spec 16 §4.1. Customers and sellers, their own tickets. Opening and posting need an Idempotency-Key and are in rate class support-message. Admins appear as "Nile Support".

body.raw:
{
  "category": "order",
  "subject": "Where is my parcel?",
  "body": "It has been a week since I ordered.",
  "orderId": "{{orderId}}",
  "attachmentMediaIds": []
}

request.description: Customers may link `orderId` and optionally one `sellerOrderId` of it; sellers send `sellerOrderId` only (an `orderId` from a seller is 400). Remove the link fields for a general question. `seller_onboarding` is for sellers. Up to 3 private images (purpose support_attachment). Stores `ticketId`. Errors (422): SUPPORT_CATEGORY_NOT_ALLOWED, ORDER_NOT_FOUND, SELLER_ORDER_NOT_FOUND, SUPPORT_OPEN_TICKET_LIMIT_REACHED, MEDIA_NOT_ATTACHABLE.
Latest activity first; `hasUnread` marks a reply you have not read.
SUPPORT_TICKET_NOT_FOUND 404 (also for another user's ticket).
Newest first (reverse to show). Attachment URLs are short-lived: refetch, don't store.
Reopens a resolved ticket. SUPPORT_TICKET_CLOSED 409: open a new ticket.

item.name: Admin: support
item.description: spec 16 §4.2. Every ticket, for any admin. Assign, resolve and close are audited; replies and notes are not.

request.description: Latest activity first. `sort=awaitingAdminSince` is the oldest-waiting queue (waiting tickets only). `assigned` with `assignedAdminId` is INVALID_QUERY. Stores the first in `ticketId`.
With the opener (name, email), the assignee and the SLA fields.
Waits for the user afterwards; the first reply on an unassigned ticket assigns it to you. SUPPORT_TICKET_CLOSED 409.
Never shown to the user; no status change; allowed on a closed ticket.
An active admin's user id, or null to unassign. The current assignee again changes nothing. SUPPORT_ASSIGNEE_INVALID 422, SUPPORT_TICKET_CLOSED 409.
The user can reopen it by writing; closed automatically after SUPPORT_AUTO_CLOSE_AFTER_HOURS. SUPPORT_TICKET_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.
For good (spam, duplicates). SUPPORT_TICKET_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.

item.name: Reviews
item.description: spec 17 §4.2. Customers review products they received: one live review per product, within REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS of delivery; edit within REVIEW_EDIT_WINDOW_DAYS. Images: upload with purpose review_image first.

request.description: Delivered items still in the window, products already reviewed left out, newest delivery first. Stores the first in `orderItemId`.
Published at once. Stores `reviewId`. Errors: REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED 422, REVIEW_WINDOW_CLOSED 422, REVIEW_ALREADY_EXISTS 409, MEDIA_NOT_ATTACHABLE 422.
Newest first; hidden ones included (status hidden, no reason).
At least one field; imageMediaIds replaces the list. REVIEW_EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED 422.
The product can be reviewed again while its window is open.
Published reviews of a visible product (PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND 404). No token needed.
Average, count and distribution, from the stored aggregate.

item.name: Seller: reviews
item.description: spec 17 §4.3. Reading works in any seller status; replying needs an approved seller.

request.description: Stores the first in `reviewId`.
Once, final. SELLER_NOT_APPROVED 403, REVIEW_HIDDEN 409, REVIEW_ALREADY_REPLIED 409.

item.name: Admin: reviews
item.description: spec 17 §4.4. Hiding a review removes it from the ratings; every action is audited.

request.description: Stores the first in `reviewId`.
REVIEW_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409 when already hidden.
REVIEW_REPLY_NOT_FOUND 404 without a reply.

item.name: Wishlist
item.description: spec 04 §8. Customers; products, not variants; WISHLIST_MAX_ITEMS per customer.

request.description: Newest first, with product cards; products no longer visible stay with available: false.
Idempotent. PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND 422 (not visible), WISHLIST_LIMIT_REACHED 422.
Always 204.
An approved seller: name, rating, member since. SELLER_NOT_FOUND 404 otherwise. No token needed.

item.name: Returns
item.description: spec 18 §4.1. Customers return delivered items within RETURN_WINDOW_DAYS of delivery; one open return per seller order. The refund is the paid amount of the returned items, less the return fee for changed_mind (the seller pays the fee for the other reasons).

request.description: What can still be returned, the window end and the current return fee. Stores the first line in orderItemId. ORDER_NOT_FOUND / SELLER_ORDER_NOT_FOUND 404, RETURN_NOT_ALLOWED / RETURN_WINDOW_CLOSED / RETURN_PICKUP_UNAVAILABLE 422.

reason: damaged | wrong_item | not_as_described (a photo is required: upload with purpose return_photo) | changed_mind. refundPayout is required for a COD order (mobile_wallet with walletNumber, or instapay with instapayAddress) and refused for Kashier: remove it then. Stores returnId. Errors: RETURN_QUANTITY_INVALID / RETURN_PHOTOS_REQUIRED / RETURN_AMOUNT_TOO_LOW / MEDIA_NOT_ATTACHABLE 422, RETURN_ALREADY_OPEN 409.
Items, photos, deadlines, the timeline and the refund status. RETURN_NOT_FOUND 404.
Until the agent picks it up. RETURN_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.
A rejected return, within the escalation window: an admin decides. RETURN_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION / RETURN_ESCALATION_WINDOW_CLOSED 409.

item.name: Seller: returns
item.description: spec 18 §4.2. Log in as the seller. Decide before sellerDecisionDeadlineAt (silence approves); inspect before inspectionDeadlineAt (silence confirms without restock).

request.description: Stores the first in returnId.
Stores the first return item in returnItemId (for Confirm receipt). RETURN_NOT_FOUND 404.
requested → approved; delivery creates the return pickup. RETURN_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.
requested → rejected; the customer may escalate. RETURN_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.

received → completed: every item of the return exactly once; restock false for damaged goods. The refund and the ledger follow. RETURN_ITEMS_MISMATCH 422, RETURN_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION / RETURN_INSPECTION_WINDOW_CLOSED 409.
received → disputed; an admin resolves it. Photos: upload with purpose return_photo. MEDIA_NOT_ATTACHABLE 422, RETURN_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.

item.name: Admin: returns
item.description: spec 18 §4.3. Admin role. Decisions and dispute resolutions are audited.

request.description: Stores the first in returnId.
With the parties, the payout method (never the details) and the full history. RETURN_NOT_FOUND 404.
requested or escalated → approved | rejected (final). RETURN_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.
disputed → completed (refund) or refused (no_refund). RETURN_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION 409.

item.name: Seller: coupons
item.description: spec 19 §4.2. Log in as the seller. Seller-funded coupons for your own products: commission is taken on the discounted subtotal (R-17). Writes need an approved seller; reads work in any status. Seller writes are not audited.

request.description: Newest first; displayStatus: scheduled | active | expired | inactive. Stores the first in couponId.

scope seller (all your products) or category (with scopeCategoryId: your products in that category and below); scopeSellerId is not accepted. discountType percent: discountValue a rate 0.01..0.90, maxDiscount optional; fixed: an amount above 0, no maxDiscount. The code (4..32 letters, digits, dashes) is upper-cased. startsAt may be past, endsAt must be future. perCustomerLimit 1..100, globalLimit null = unlimited. SELLER_NOT_APPROVED 403, COUPON_INVALID 422 (details), CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND 422, COUPON_CODE_TAKEN 409. Stores couponId and couponCode.
adminBlocked and adminBlockReason show a block. COUPON_NOT_FOUND 404 (also another seller's).

Any create field but code, plus status; at least one. After the first use only endsAt, globalLimit (not below the uses) and status (COUPON_LOCKED 409). A blocked coupon cannot be activated (COUPON_BLOCKED 409). COUPON_NOT_FOUND 404, COUPON_INVALID 422, SELLER_NOT_APPROVED 403.

item.name: Admin: coupons
item.description: spec 19 §4.3. Admin role. Platform-funded coupons (the platform absorbs the discount, commission on the undiscounted subtotal) and the block of seller coupons. Every write is audited.

request.description: Newest first. code is matched as stored (upper-case). Stores the first in couponId.

scope all, seller (with scopeSellerId) or category (with scopeCategoryId). discountType percent: discountValue a rate 0.01..0.90, maxDiscount optional; fixed: an amount above 0, no maxDiscount. The code (4..32 letters, digits, dashes) is upper-cased. startsAt may be past, endsAt must be future. perCustomerLimit 1..100, globalLimit null = unlimited. COUPON_INVALID 422 (details), CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND / SELLER_NOT_FOUND 422, COUPON_CODE_TAKEN 409. Stores couponId and couponCode.
With its last 50 redemptions (active or released). COUPON_NOT_FOUND 404.
As a seller changes theirs. A seller coupon is blocked or unblocked instead (COUPON_SELLER_FUNDED 409). COUPON_NOT_FOUND 404, COUPON_LOCKED 409, COUPON_INVALID 422.

The coupon goes inactive and its seller cannot activate it; the seller is notified (coupon_blocked). reason 3..500, kept in the audit log. COUPON_NOT_FOUND 404, COUPON_BLOCK_INVALID_STATUS 409 (a platform coupon, or already blocked).
Clears the block; the coupon stays inactive for the seller to activate. COUPON_NOT_FOUND 404, COUPON_BLOCK_INVALID_STATUS 409.

item.description: Local docker-compose only (EMAIL_PROVIDER=mailpit). Reads the latest email sent to {{email}} and stores its OTP or invite token. Inbox UI: {{mailpitUrl}}

request.description: Mailpit search API. Change `email` to look at another inbox (e.g. the invited admin).

pm.test('found an OTP or an invite token', () => pm.expect(Boolean(invite || otp)).to.be.true);
